title: One Exchange, Two Figures
label: ch:mw-numbered-exchange
canDo: I can run a six-turn counter exchange in which both sides name an amount, at a shop, a food stall, and a rickshaw.

payoff.summary: The twelve numbers and ten figures are retrieved at a distance, run over the shopping, food, and transport words in turn, and the five-turn exchange of chapter 31 is then re-run with the seller's figure and the buyer's offer in it.
